[ASSISTANT_SAID] Upgrading RAM can improve overall performance and breathe new life into a system.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Before starting the upgrade, check system compatibility, determine how much RAM is needed, and check current RAM configuration.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended RAM options include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Crucial: High-quality RAM with a wide range of modules.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Corsair: Popular among gamers, offering high-performance RAM.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Kingston: Offers a variety of RAM modules, including high-capacity options.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested RAM kits:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Crucial 16 GB (2x8 GB) DDR4 3200 MHz: Great for general use and gaming.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Corsair Vengeance LPX 16 GB (2x8 GB) DDR4 3200 MHz: High-performance with a stylish design.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Kingston HyperX Fury 32 GB (2x16 GB) DDR4 2400 MHz: High-capacity for heavy users.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Steps to upgrade RAM include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Purchase the right RAM.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Shut down the computer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Ground yourself to avoid static damage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Open the computer case.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Locate the RAM slots.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Remove existing RAM if necessary.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Install the new RAM.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Secure the RAM.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Replace the side panel.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Boot up the computer and check BIOS for recognition of new RAM.
